items.heading: Classic Cheeseburger
details: Key ingredients: ground beef, cheese slices, burger buns, lettuce, tomato, pickles
Shape ground beef into patties and season with salt and pepper.
Sear on a hot griddle, flipping once, and melt cheese on top.
Toast the buns lightly.
Assemble with lettuce, tomato, pickles and condiments of choice.

items.heading: BBQ Pulled Pork
details: Key ingredients: pork shoulder, dry rub spices, barbecue sauce, burger buns
Rub pork shoulder generously with a spice blend.
Slow-cook or smoke until the meat is fall-apart tender.
Shred the meat with two forks and mix with barbecue sauce.
Pile onto soft buns and serve with coleslaw.

items.heading: Apple Pie
details: Key ingredients: apples, pie crust, sugar, cinnamon, butter, lemon juice
Toss sliced apples with sugar, cinnamon and a splash of lemon juice.
Line a pie dish with crust and fill with the apple mixture, dotting with butter.
Cover with a top crust, sealing and venting the edges.
Bake until the crust is golden and the filling bubbles.
